name: Matt Huang
current_role: Co-founder & Managing Partner, Paradigm; founder & project lead, Tempo (payments blockchain incubated by Stripe and Paradigm)
profile: MIT math grad and former Sequoia partner (early in ByteDance, Instacart, Benchling) who co-founded crypto/frontier-tech investor Paradigm in 2018. He sits on the boards of Stripe and Kalshi and leads Tempo, a payments-first Layer 1 for stablecoins co-founded by Paradigm and Stripe (valued ~$5B).
interesting_fact: Stripe CEO Patrick Collison says Tempo is now Stripe's default blockchain for new features.
deep_cut_fact: Before venture capital he founded Hotspots, a Y Combinator company that Twitter acquired in 2012.
notes: Paradigm lists an executive assistant (Anita Wong) on his profile, with no published email; Paradigm contact page is the formal route. Tempo press email is best for a payments/stablecoin angle.

name: Jacob Kimmel
current_role: Co-founder & CEO, NewLimit (epigenetic-reprogramming medicines for aging)
profile: UCSF stem-cell biology PhD whose work spans molecular biology and computer science; he was a Principal Investigator at Calico running an epigenetic-reprogramming lab before co-founding NewLimit in 2022 with Brian Armstrong and Blake Byers. He rose from Head of Research to President to CEO; NewLimit is valued ~$2B.
interesting_fact: NewLimit uses an AI system to design transcription-factor 'payloads' that make old cells act young, testing thousands of designs at once; it reports restoring youthful function in aged liver cells.
deep_cut_fact: At Calico (Alphabet's aging company) his PI lab developed methods to engineer cell identity and reprogram cell age, the work that became NewLimit's core thesis.
notes: No published press email found for NewLimit. Publishes detailed public progress updates, so good for a science-led interview.

name: Hitoshi Harada
profile: Japanese database engineer who started in 2002 building data infrastructure for Japan's biggest online travel agencies, then was a lead architect at Greenplum (acquired by EMC). He co-founded Alpaca with Yoshi Yokokawa; Alpaca's brokerage APIs serve apps worldwide and it has raised ~$320M.
interesting_fact: He and Yokokawa named the company after the pet alpacas they saw next to Masayoshi Son's Woodside house under construction.
deep_cut_fact: He is a frequent open-source contributor known for the Window Functions feature in PostgreSQL.
notes: Engineer-first profile; mentioning his PostgreSQL window functions work would resonate.

name: Andre Cronje
current_role: Founder, Flying Tulip (on-chain lending, yield and trading)
profile: South African DeFi developer with 20+ years of software experience: original technical architect of the Fantom network, creator of Yearn Finance and Keep3r Network, later CTO and board member of Sonic Labs (Fantom's successor). He now builds Flying Tulip, whose FT token sale (10B supply at 10 FT per $1) implies ~$1B.
interesting_fact: Flying Tulip's token sale attaches an on-chain 'Perpetual PUT' to each primary FT position, letting holders exit for their backing capital.
deep_cut_fact: Before his DeFi fame he co-founded the crypto news site Crypto Briefing and served as its Chief Code Reviewer, auditing projects' code.
notes: Very active on X personally (handle not verified from an official page here); historically has stepped away from public life at times. Best route is X.
